# VSCO

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 0 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Photo-product marketing: white 88px nav over a #111 band, gold pill for the free trial, black pill for the solid action, 4px fields on the signed-out login.

Captured 2026-11-19, signed out (public marketing and the login form; nothing submitted). Themes: light.

Tokens and component notes for VSCO, the photo editor at https://www.vsco.co/, captured **2026-11-19**. Signed out the whole time. CSS readings came from a live preview tab at 1169×731, device pixel ratio 2.

The home page loaded with title "VSCO: Photo Editor + Filters, Community, and Business Tools" and no Cloudflare challenge. Pricing and the signed-out login also loaded in that tab. The preview browser returned "The browser is not producing screenshot frames," so this package has measurements and no screenshots. The slug is `vsco`.

## Typography

11 styles from `core.typography`. `fontFamily` is the first family of each stack; the full stacks, and properties DESIGN.md has no field for (text case, decoration), are in tokens.json. Families: VSCO Gothic.

### Fonts (from README.md)

VSCO Gothic is the product face. Computed on the marketing pages as `"VSCO Gothic", sans-serif`. Computed on login as `"VSCO Gothic", -apple-system, system-ui, "Segoe UI", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif`, plus an emoji fallback stack that the token shortens. Weights seen: 400, 500, 600, 700. The files are woff2 on cdn.prod.website-files.com. They are proprietary and are not in this package. The style guide falls back to the system sans.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

Display and title sizes are the computed sizes at 1169px, including fractional pixels. They will differ at another width. The 390px phone width was not measured.

`--dark-grey`, `--gold-on-white`, `--surface-green`, and `--100-red-l` are declared and were not painted on the captured elements. Hover colours are declared in CSS and were not forced on a live control.

The empty login submit is #aaaaaa. That is the empty state, not a brand accent. The pink #ff0877 bar is a promo, not a named custom property.

VSCO Gothic is served from the VSCO Webflow CDN. This package does not include the font files.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

1. **Paint the home band in #111111.** The marketing body class is `background-color-black-ish` and the computed background is rgb(17, 17, 17). [tokens.json](tokens.json)
2. **Keep the nav white.** The marketing nav computed rgb(255, 255, 255) at 88px tall with 40px of side padding. [tokens.json](tokens.json)
3. **Use gold for the free-trial pill.** Try VSCO for free and Copy code computed rgb(255, 188, 60) with black text. [tokens.json](tokens.json)
4. **Use black for the solid pill.** Explore VSCO and Select Pro computed a black fill and white text at 999px radius. [tokens.json](tokens.json)
5. **Don't treat pink as the brand accent.** Learn more in the Studio Pro bar computed rgb(255, 8, 119). It is a promo fill, not a `:root` custom property. [tokens.json](tokens.json)
6. **Don't submit the login form from this package.** The page offers email and password, Google, and Apple. Nothing was submitted. [patterns.md](patterns.md)
7. **Don't invent a painted dark theme.** No theme toggle was used, and no dark set was painted. [tokens.json](tokens.json)
8. **Don't ship VSCO Gothic.** The face is on the VSCO CDN and is not in this package. [style-guide.html](style-guide.html)
